title: Audit Without Leaking
prompt:
`AuditLog.Write(action, email)` pastes the raw email into every
line — the log file becomes a personal-data store. Write
`Solution.Audit(string action, string email)` returning the safe line:

```csharp
public static class Solution
{
    public static string Audit(string action, string email);
}
```

Contract:

- the line is exactly `"<action> email=***"` — the email never appears,
  not even partially, whatever its content,
- `email` of `null` or empty produces the same `email=***` (nothing to
  correlate, nothing to leak),
- the action text is preserved verbatim (including spaces).

tests.name: the raw email never reaches the line
tests.hint: Mask fully; partial masking leaks partial identities.

tests.name: empty or missing email still logs the action
tests.code:
Cj.Eq(Solution.Audit("LOGOUT", ""), "LOGOUT email=***", "empty email");
Cj.Eq(Solution.Audit("LOGOUT", null), "LOGOUT email=***", "null email");
tests.hint: No identity is not an error — it is just nothing to leak.

tests.name: action text is preserved verbatim
tests.code: Cj.Eq(Solution.Audit("PWD RESET REQUESTED", "x@y.z"), "PWD RESET REQUESTED email=***", "verbatim action");
tests.hint: The event description is the useful part — keep it exact.
